name: C6-1 World model next state
description: State and action in, prediction out

params.label: Predicted next state (1, 4) — replaces a step of real environment

data.noteContent:
The smallest thing that still deserves the name world model. A four-number state and a two-number action are joined into a six-number context; a Linear, a ReLU and a second Linear turn that into a four-number guess at the next state.

Both inputs are fixed values rather than random draws, so the only thing moving between runs is the untrained weights. Nothing is learned. The point is the signature - state plus action in, next state out - the same whether the state is four numbers or a video frame.

Chain a second copy of these three layers onto the output and you have a two-step rollout: the model imagining ahead without touching the environment.

還配得上世界模型這個名字的最小形式。四個數字的狀態和兩個數字的動作接成六個數字的脈絡；一顆 Linear、一個 ReLU、再一顆 Linear，把它變成對下一個狀態的四個數字猜測。

兩個輸入都是固定值，不是隨機抽的，所以每次執行之間會變的只有未訓練的權重。這裡沒有學習。重點是那個介面 - 輸入狀態加動作、輸出下一個狀態 - 不管狀態是四個數字還是一張影格，都一樣。

把這三層再接一份到輸出後面，就是兩步的 rollout：模型不碰真實環境，自己往前想。

Concatenation is the whole interface. The state is (1, 4) and the action is (1, 2); joining them on dim 1 gives (1, 6), which is why the first Linear declares in_features 6. Give the agent a third action number and that 6 has to become a 7.

串接就是整個介面。狀態是 (1, 4)、動作是 (1, 2)，沿著 dim 1 接起來變成 (1, 6)，所以第一顆 Linear 的 in_features 才寫 6。如果動作多一個數字，這個 6 就要改成 7。
